newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks open higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks open higher.

text.p: U.S. stocks were higher across the board at Wednesday's opening in a continuation of Tuesday's rally.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up 12 points to 5,916, the NASDAQ Index up four to 1,225 and the S&P Index up one at 690.
New York Stock Exchange advances led declines by 487/219, while NASDAQ advances topped declines 951/575.
The long bond was up 8/32 to yield 6.86 percent.
